owner_role: Supervisor selecting the independent Analyst's current-base measurement
hypothesis: A small current-eight-layer native component measurement can distinguish plausible attention versus activation work worth optimizing; the old six-layer monolithic trace cannot do so.
single_causal_change: Explicit development-only component timing mode; default-OFF production source remains audited e1e2.

control.reference: Actual plain Torch SDPA and original _FusedMLP operations, not a competing model or evaluator.

candidate.binding_requirement: Operator resolves exact host label/output/cache paths and argv in prepared packet before assignment; use unchanged source and existing direct diagnostic guardian.
candidate.legal_shape: Full chip, LNC2/four ranks; BF16 B32/T1024/H8/D128 attention and32768x1024 MLP with4096 hidden.

gates.cpu_exactness: Author and independent scalar-loop BF16 MLP/splits and masked-softmax attention references PASS
gates.flag_off_three_steps: Author actual tiny8layer OFF3 bitidentity PASS; independent AST disabled-path identity PASS
gates.review_scope: PASS_FOR_NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC only; native support and timing untested. Mandatory repository-contract reading was disclosed, no implementer branch/notes/shared P3 analysis accessed.
gates.fresh_machine_checks: Original lifetime flock, in-lock ps and neuron-ls, source/argv/cache/resource checks. One job per host. P0 train+attached20M must finish; K2 retains priority.

protocol.native_calls: Exact SDPA and original full custom MLP forward/backward, followed by separately materialized activation and matrix boundaries defined in SPEC.
protocol.first_calls: Report separately as compilation plus execution, not pure compiler duration. Use one genuinely empty private cache namespace; no unsupported warm/cold claims.
protocol.steady_measurement: Two warmup blocks, four timed blocks, three calls/block, synchronized boundaries, all four ranks; report raw times, medians and slowest-rank contention.
protocol.duration: 900-second source watchdog plus existing Operator hard process-tree supervision and bounded cleanup; daemon timeout alone is insufficient.
protocol.inputs: Bounded synthetic random seed42 tensors only; no training/validation/external data.
protocol.output: Small per-rank incremental component JSON and logs; no checkpoint, training, eval, profiler, NTFF or decoder.
protocol.runner: Direct development diagnostic under existing guardian, never a submission rehearsal expecting fake optimizer-step markers.

success_criteria.diagnostic: All four ranks finish with finite outputs/gradients and complete requested records. Native unsupported compilation/VJP/synchronization is a failed diagnostic, not a slow-kernel result.
success_criteria.interpretation: Nonadditive materialized component costs only; not exclusive in-graph percentages, no subtraction/multiplication into claimed whole-step savings, no BPB improvement or adoption.
success_criteria.followup: Only measured evidence may nominate a later P3 patch under the same existing three gates; no extra gate introduced by this diagnostic.

retry_policy: Preserve exact failure; one diagnosed unique-label retry, then park. Reap all owned descendants and verify independent idle before lock release.
artifacts: Exact source/argv/environment/cache provenance, per-rank raw timing/finite records, wall time, failure or verdict and safe quiescence receipt.
